subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should agent-originated `message(action=send)` deliveries receive selected provider/model/thinking context for `messages.responsePrefix` templates, or should tool sends intentionally remain static/identity-only?
rationale: Current main deliberately skips unresolved dynamic prefixes because the message-tool send path does not perform model selection, so completing the request requires choosing a runtime contract and owner boundary.

options.title: Thread run context into sends
options.body: Apply dynamic responsePrefix templates for agent-originated message-tool sends using the actual selected provider, model, full model ref, and thinking level, while preserving unresolved-placeholder skipping for sends without run context.

options.title: Document static/identity only
options.body: Keep current behavior and document that message-tool sends support only static and identity prefixes unless a future owner designs run-context plumbing.

options.title: Split a narrower design tracker
options.body: Replace this broad tracker with a narrower design issue that owns selected-model prefix parity separately from the already-merged static/identity fix.

recommendation.title: Thread run context into sends
recommendation.body: Apply dynamic responsePrefix templates for agent-originated message-tool sends using the actual selected provider, model, full model ref, and thinking level, while preserving unresolved-placeholder skipping for sends without run context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent message-routing and prefix-context history makes this the best available owner for the remaining contract decision.
